attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his newsletter, presented as his own view.

semantics.note: The drafter dropped 'I hypothesize' and set the modality to 'will'. A hypothesis is a tentative conjecture, like 'I suspect', and the context says so too ('If my hypothesis... is true', 'If I'm right'). It is a hedged forecast.

contract.note: The contract treats a hedged hypothesis as a firm expectation and scores it on a plain reading. Plain-reading scoring applies only to firm language. The contract also chose the growth measure itself (revenue and WAU).

evidence.note: Run rate went from $5.5B (Dec 2024) to $10B (Jun 2025). That is no dramatic slowdown, but the claim is hedged and so not scored.
500M weekly users by March 2025, against a 250M baseline. Growth continued.
Company baseline of 250M weekly users on the day of the post.
CFO's full-year ARR figures. A company disclosure, and outside the early-2025 window.
The round closed. That part was a concession and is not the tested claim.

reviews.rationale: The growth forecast is framed as 'I hypothesize'. That signals tentative confidence, like 'I suspect', and the policy does not score such claims. The evidence (run rate up about 82% in six months, weekly users doubled) would contradict a firm forecast, but this claim is hedged, so it is not adjudicable.

attribution.note: Zitron's own sentence in his newsletter.

semantics.note: The normalised proposition leaves out the firm timetable for conversion ('next six or so months'). The contract restores it as part (b), so the scoring covers the full statement.

contract.note: Splitting the claim into three parts is fair, and so is the generous reading of six months as through mid-2025. Part (a) depends on which loss measure is used: $5.09B attributable counts as about $5B, while the pre-allocation figure is uncited.

evidence.note: Audited 2024 net loss attributable to OpenAI was $5.09B, which is about $5B, at the top of the range.
In May 2025, seven months on, there was no conversion and the plan had been revised.
Recapitalization completed on 2025-10-28, about 13 months after the post. That is well past six or so months.
Reported Q1 2026 operating loss of $9.3B, after conversion. OpenAI kept losing money.

reviews.rationale: Two parts hold: the 2024 loss of about $5B (audited $5.09B attributable) and continued losses after conversion (Q1 2026 operating loss of $9.3B). The conversion timetable fails: it was completed in October 2025, about 13 months later, not within six or so months.
